title: Are Detectors Fair to Indian IP-AIGC? A Cross-Generator Study

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance (Accuracy, AUC, AP, EER) of state-of-the-art deepfake/AIGC detectors on datasets specifically curated with Indian and South-Asian faces to measure generalization gaps and fairness, particularly in identity-preserving AIGC (IP-AIGC) settings.
